A lists of spells available to be prepared by the Druid class.

Overview

Druid spells are Prepared spells, so all Druids have access to these spells (up to their Druid level) and prepare a limited number of them at any one time.

Druid spells will use the caster's Wisdom modifier for Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.
